subject: english
stem: Which sentence correctly contrasts two near groups with two far groups?
options: These flower are fresh; those flower are dry.
Those here flowers are these far flowers.
These flowers are fresh; those flowers are dry.
This flowers is fresh; that flowers is dry.

optionRationales.reason: These flower are fresh; those flower are dry.：名詞未用複數。
Those here flowers are these far flowers.：指示距離與位置詞衝突。
These flowers are fresh; those flowers are dry.：兩組皆複數，近遠分別使用 these/those。
This flowers is fresh; that flowers is dry.：兩組數皆不合。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「在複數對象中，以群組邊界、說話者視角與近遠線索選 these 或 those，並維持複數名詞及 be 一致。」可推出 These flowers are fresh; those flowers are dry.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 These flowers are fresh; those flowers are dry. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
